newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm to stronger with crude gain.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm to stronger with crude gain.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to stronger on Tuesday as the market was bouyed by firmer crude.
Gas oil prices were firmer quiet trade with the market tracking benchmark IPE gas oil as premiums for spot barges and cargoes held steady.
Traders said tight nearby supply was holding barge and cargo premiums to gas oil futures steady, but talk of growing cargo supplies weakened early August premiums for heating oil a little.

High sulphur fuel oil barges ended largely steady but off Monday's highs but traders said the low demand made them sceptical of the move to higher levels. Low demand pressured low sulphur barges, with some sellers cutting their price to $94.50/$95.
High sulphur cracked cargoes traded steady to stronger, especially for Russian material. One percent was flat, quietly talked in the $93/$94 region.
Gasoline was up to $2 a tonne firmer on swaps while barges were concluded at $184-186.50 on eurograde and $177 fob on regular.
